# Implementation Plan: Manual and Countdown MVP

**Branch**: `007-manual-countdown-mvp` | **Date**: 2026-07-29 | **Spec**: [spec.md](file:///c:/Users/markc/_Projects/micro-controller/smartflow/specs/007-manual-countdown-mvp/spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/007-manual-countdown-mvp/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan is generated by `/speckit-plan`. See `.specify/templates/plan-template.md` for the execution workflow.

---

## Summary

Implement the Manual and Countdown operating modes for the Master Node as a fully autonomous local pump controller. Sensor communication (RS-485), Auto mode logic, and sensor-based flow dependencies are intentionally deferred and disabled to ensure independent execution.

---

## Constitution Gate *(must pass before Phase 0)*

| Principle | Status | Evidence |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| I. Fail Toward Pump OFF | ☐ Pass | Relay defaults to OFF on boot; timeouts and errors trigger `setPump(false)`. |
| II. Dry-Run Lockout | ☐ Pass | Exit paths remain intact, but logic won't trigger falsely without flow data. |
| III. Overflow Protection | ☐ Pass | Both Manual and Countdown modes strictly enforce `cfgMaxPumpRuntimeMin`. |
| IV. TOR Independence | ☐ Pass | Software control via `setPump()` does not override physical TOR. |
| V. Sensor Freshness / E-Stop | ☐ Pass | Emergency stop handling remains available; sensor freshness logic is bypassed. |
| VI. Backward Compatibility | ☐ Pass | Existing RTDB schema is preserved; modes utilize existing commands. |

*Re-check this gate after Phase 1 design completes.*

## Phase 1: Design

**Purpose**: Finalize contracts and schema before writing implementation code

### Phase 1A: Firmware Design 
- [x] Disable RS-485: Map `rs485_master.cpp` initialization to immediately return or skip polling.
- [x] State Machine: Design IDLE -> MANUAL -> COUNTDOWN -> ERROR transitions.
- [x] Timer arithmetic: Ensure Countdown uses `elapsedMillis32()`.

**Checkpoint**: Constitution re-check — all design outputs reviewed against §IV principles

---

## Phase 2: Firmware Implementation 

**Build command**: `cd firmware/master_node && pio run`
**Validation**: Hardware serial monitor

- [ ] [FW-001] Modify `main.cpp` and `rs485_master.cpp` to explicitly disable RS-485 initialization and polling.
- [ ] [FW-002] Update `firebase_control.cpp` to separate command reception from execution.
- [ ] [FW-003] Implement FR-009 mode priorities and FR-011 STOP behavior in state machine.
- [ ] [FW-004] Implement `elapsedMillis32()` wrap-safe tracking for Countdown (FR-008).
- [ ] [FW-005] Enforce `cfgMaxPumpRuntimeMin` overflow protection (FR-006).
- [ ] [FW-006] Verify `setPump()` is the only relay control entry point (grep check).
- [ ] [FW-007] Verify relay default state after MCU boot is OFF.

**Checkpoint**: Firmware builds clean, relay disposition verified against constitution
